Posterior inclusion probabilities as a long edge table

Source: R/generics.R
pip_table.Rd

Generic for extracting edge-level posterior inclusion probabilities (PIPs) from a fitted multiple-GGM model, in a format shared by all packages that implement it, so that one downstream script works on any of their fits.

Usage

pip_table(fit, ...)

Arguments

fit

A fitted model object.

...

Passed to methods (e.g. which ladder step or chain to use).

Value

A data frame with one row per edge \(i < j\) and group, ordered by group and then in upper.tri() order, with columns

i, j

Variable indices, \(i < j\).

node1, node2

Variable names.

group

Group name (character).

pip

Posterior probability that the edge is in that group's graph.

Methods document how their PIPs are defined. For example, in spikeyglass the edge indicator is shared by all groups, so pip is identical across groups; in multiGGMr each group has its own graph.

See also

pcor_estimate(), edge_index()
